Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card’s inherited effect even if my opponent's Digimon and the Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards are deleted at the same timing?

Effect: [When Digivolving] ＜Draw 1＞ and trash 1 card in your hand. Then, if [Growlmon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, until the end of your opponent's turn, this Digimon gains "[On Deletion] You may play 1 card with [Guilmon] in its name from your trash without paying the cost."
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon are deleted, gain 1 memory.
